title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Mr Blue Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Mr Blue Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod delivers a bold blend of dark berries with an icy lift. Blueberry, Blackberry, and Blackcurrant combine for a rich fruit base, while a streak of cool Menthol brightens the finish for a layered and refreshing vape. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. Together they deliver up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, removing the need for coil changes or messy refills. With a 0.8ohm mesh coil built in, the pod provides consistent vapour production and vibrant flavour throughout. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to go.
